answer: Work waits on the oasis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the haven of the next round. By the zenith of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit.
